visual.general_description: Five-panel composite: three colour fundus photographs (a to c) and two infrared-plus-OCT image pairs (d and e).
visual.detailed_description: Panels a to c are round colour fundus photographs showing a bright yellow-white rounded area within a dark rim right of centre, a broad pale band of confluent spots along the left side in panel b, and a dark mottled pigmented band in panel c. Panels d and e each pair a greyscale infrared fundus image carrying a green arrow with an OCT cross-section; d shows a central foveal depression and e shows a thin layer separated from the layers below by a dark space. Panel letters a to e are printed at the lower left of each panel.

panels.general_description: Colour fundus photograph (panel a) with a bright yellow-white rounded area inside a dark pigmented rim and a curved band-like margin beside it.

Right of centre is a bright yellow-white rounded area surrounded by a dark mottled brown rim and a darker region; a pale curved arc with a lighter crescent-shaped band lies immediately to its left. A small irregular pale streak lies above the bright area. Retinal vessels run through the left half. The periphery to the right is paler yellowish. No arrows, measurements or text other than the panel letter a are visible.
